visual_action: A montage of short clips showing President Joe Biden inside a Wawa convenience store. He is seen at a counter, turning and smiling at the camera, using a self-service kiosk, being handed a milkshake, and then walking towards the exit with the drink.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Joe Biden is seen in every shot of the video and is identified by name in the on-screen text: 'President Biden'.

cast.name: Wawa
cast.evidence: The on-screen text identifies the location as Wawa: 'President Biden stops by Wawa for a milkshake'.

on_screen_text.text: President Biden stops by Wawa for a milkshake

spoken_summary: There is no speech or dialogue in the video; it is set entirely to music.
audio_music: The video features an upbeat, high-energy instrumental track throughout, identified as PSY's 'Gangnam Style'. The music creates a fun and lighthearted mood.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between different scenes of Biden's visit.
central_claim: President Biden is a relatable, down-to-earth person who enjoys common experiences like getting a milkshake at Wawa.
intended_effect: To make the viewer see President Biden in a positive, humanizing, and likable light.
